title: PiWeb Disable payment method / Partial payment for WooCommerce before 1.1.10.9 contains a missing authorization…
description: PiWeb Disable payment method / Partial payment for WooCommerce versions before 1.1.10.9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the update_fees AJAX handler. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to modify and read other customers' orders by reusing a nonce from their own order-pay page and supplying sequential order_id values. The vulnerability enables attackers to change payment methods, recalculate fees, and disclose order details such as line items and totals.
